meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自查并单审已完成工作，核验目标、质量与安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你刚完成功能开发，想在提交PR前做一次独立的把关审查。
copy.tagline_en: Gate-check completed work with a single reviewer before handoff.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just finished coding and want an independent check before a PR handoff.

howto.what: Claude 会先在真实界面上亲手做手动 QA(主路径、最险边界、相邻回归),制成测试矩阵;再启动唯一一个 gate 审查代理,核对目标、约束、代码质量、安全与 QA 证据,给出批准或否决。矩阵无失败行且代理批准才判通过。
howto.when: 用户明确要求评审已完成的工作,或准备 PR 交付并提出评审时触发。评审对象只针对已完成实现。

say.text: 我刚写完这次改动,帮我做完工评审。
say.note: Claude 会先手动实测,再造唯一一个审查代理下结论。

say.text: PR 要交付了,先按流程把这次完成的代码评审一遍。
say.note: 会跑手动 QA,再让唯一一个 gate 审查代理给结论。

say.text: 这个分支的活干完了,帮我查一遍有没有漏掉上下文和风险。
say.note: 若存在失败的 QA 行会直接判失败。

howto.what_en: Claude first does hands-on QA on the real surface, then sends one gate-review subagent to audit goal, constraints, code, security, missing context and QA evidence. It approves only if all QA rows pass and the reviewer says APPROVE.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks to review completed work, or before a PR handoff when a review of finished implementation is requested.

say_en.text: I just finished this change—please run a completion review on it.
say_en.note: Claude runs manual QA first, then one reviewing agent.

say_en.text: This PR is about to ship. Do the gate review per your process.
say_en.note: Expect manual QA plus one gate reviewer verdict.

say_en.text: This branch's work is done—check for missed context and risks before handoff.
say_en.note: Any failing QA row makes the review fail immediately.
